OE-1: Management Processes support the needs of a large, multiple-system library consortium and its individual component systems and branches. Specifically, the system must support a library consortium with 286 locations, 17 million annual circulations, purchasing and processing over 900,000 items per year. 1.5 User Classes and Characteristics

Patron A Patron is a customer of King County Library System, either possessing a library card or not, either on site of a community library or not, using either print materials, media materials, or electronic resources.

Staff Staff include managers, librarians, library technicians, library assistants, and library pages who are involved in designing and providing services for the Library. System Administrators

Library Managers

Library Managers include Cluster and Site Managers who provide input to the design and implementation of Library services.
